description: This file defines the 'Task' class for managing scheduled tasks (cron jobs) within the OpenCart admin module. It includes a method 'index' that checks for ongoing tasks and initiates a new process if none are running.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class that handles the execution of scheduled task jobs, starting processes if needed.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to check for running tasks and start a new process if none are active.
